strategy_name: K-pop Reel Scout v3.1 Dual Engine
goal: maximize follower conversion for @kpopcoreamx among Mexican K-pop fans while testing whether motion-based viral moments improve retention, shares and follows versus static news-card Reels

NEWS.source_priority: official first-party sources, ticketing, promoters, charts, broadcasters and reliable media
NEWS.candidate_scoring: use the existing v3.0 scoring and hook competition unchanged

minimum_conditions: The clip has a real current viral signal, not only a high historical view count.
There is a natural reason Mexican K-pop fans would care now.
There is enough verified context to add original Spanish/Mexico value instead of merely reposting.
The clip can plausibly produce stronger retention, shares or follows than a static card Reel.
VIRAL.dm_share_test: Would a Mexican fan send this moment to another fan because it is funny, emotional, impressive, surprising, useful or directly connected to Mexico?

production_style.principle: Emotion-first hybrid: let the moment breathe, then add Mexico utility, then a short follow/comment CTA.
production_style.overlay_rule: Use the minimum text needed. Do not cover the subject or turn the clip back into a moving card-news post.
production_style.first_hook_rule: Prefer artist/fandom + CDMX/Mexico + a concrete emotional question or verified reason to care.
production_style.cta_rule: Use a low-friction choice or one-word response plus a specific Mexico update promise when truthful.

daily_selection.rule: At final selection, compare the strongest NEWS candidate and strongest VIRAL candidate. Produce only the stronger candidate when it passes its engine threshold and the shared quality gate. Do not force a post when both are weak.

test_1.format: emotion-first hybrid with Mexico bridge and source audio retained

validation_phase.decision_rule: Do not permanently favor VIRAL or NEWS from one result. Require at least 3 valid Viral Reel samples before changing portfolio weights or thresholds.
validation_phase.success_signal: Viral format should materially improve retention and/or shares/follows relative to recent news-card Reels, not merely raw views.

safety_and_originality.rule: Do not build the strategy around downloading and blindly reuploading other creators' clips. Benchmark the viral mechanism and add meaningful Mexico-specific editorial value, attribution and source context. Prefer official/remix-permitted/authorized sources when available.
